topic: Traffic discrepancy when filtering by city
summary_markdown:
A user noted a significant difference in Unique Traffic (Screen) for Clearchannel Latvia facilities in Riga when comparing unfiltered data to data filtered by city. It was speculated that the discrepancy might be due to how frequency formulas are processed.

It was suggested that calculations requiring hourly facility-level processing might rely on a hardcoded list of companies, and Clearchannel Latvia may not be included in this specific list.
action_items: Investigate the cause of unique traffic discrepancy between filtered and unfiltered data for Riga facilities.
